fact: A merchant interrupts a sale to threaten Gyrgum with death, then resumes the sale as if nothing happened.
source_quote: the merchant broke off mid-sale to threaten to kill him, then carried on as if nothing had happened
subject: merchant threat interruption

fact: The duergar merchants in Gracklstugh are behaving erratically and nonsensically.
source_quote: the party notices the increasingly erratic and nonsensical behavior of the duergar merchants throughout the bazaar
subject: duergar merchants

fact: Gyrgum rolls a 15 on Insight and senses 'there's something off' about a duergar merchant.
source_quote: Gyrgum rolls Insight (15) and senses "there's something off"
subject: Gyrgum insight check

fact: A duergar merchant constantly asks the opinion of a twin brother who does not exist.
source_quote: The party observes a duergar merchant constantly asking the opinion of a non-existent twin brother
subject: invisible twin merchant

fact: Gyrgum wonders if the duergar are speaking to invisible duergar.
source_quote: Gyrgum wonders whether they are talking to invisible duergar
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Daz asks if the duergar can see into the Ethereal Plane, comparing them to people who see dead people.
source_quote: Daz wonders whether they can see into the Ethereal Plane: "Is it like they see dead people?"
subject: Daz

fact: A duergar confirms that the merchant speaking to a twin is an only child.
source_quote: Another duergar confirms: "there's no twin brother. He's an only child."
subject: confirming duergar

fact: Several duergar merchants quote different prices for the same items repeatedly, insisting the buyers change the terms.
source_quote: Several duergar merchants give different prices to buy or sell every time they are asked about the same items, insisting it is the buyers who are changing the terms
subject: price-fluctuating merchants

fact: A duergar merchant turns completely invisible in the middle of a transaction but continues speaking.
source_quote: A duergar merchant suddenly turns invisible in the middle of a transaction but keeps speaking as if nothing has happened
subject: invisibility mid-transaction

fact: The invisible duergar merchant is described as 'slightly not quite there'.
source_quote: something very odd about everybody's behavior as if they're slightly not quite there
subject: invisible duergar

fact: Gyrgum senses something deeply wrong with the duergar of the city.
source_quote: Gyrgum senses something deeply wrong with the duergar of the city
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum steps outside the Blade Bazaar just as a stone giant arrives.
source_quote: Gyrgum senses something deeply wrong with the duergar of the city, then steps outside the bazaar and looks around just as the stone giant arrives
subject: Gyrgum leaves bazaar

fact: A stone giant arrives at the Blade Bazaar.
source_quote: looks around just as the stone giant arrives
subject: stone giant

fact: The party perceives a creeping madness in Gracklstugh similar to the frenzy of the kuo-toa.
source_quote: The creeping madness that had haunted the party throughout their time in the Underdark seemed to have seeped into the very stones of Gracklstugh itself
subject: Underdark madness

fact: Gracklstugh is a city in the Underdark inhabited by duergar and stone giants.
source_quote: seeped into the very stones of Gracklstugh itself... duergar merchants... stone giant arrives
subject: Gracklstugh

fact: The Blade Bazaar is a market in Gracklstugh where merchants sell scrolls and goods.
